text: Applied at: proof storage (`add_proofs`), proof lookup (`select_proofs`), deposit accepted-mint check (`mod.rs`), send mint resolution (`send.rs`, keeping the recipient's raw string for the actual `u` tag — never rewritten, only the comparison is canonical), redeem accepted-mint check (`redeem.rs`), and the ledger's `TokenAdded` fact mint key in `token_event.rs`/`send_worker.rs`/`redeem_worker.rs` (so balances don't fragment into multiple rows for one real mint spelled two ways — this last part wasn't in your original checklist but a codex review round caught it as a real projection-correctness gap and I closed it).
